paragraphs: Vela 2.0 Studio is a playground for the Vela 2.0 model family by KR Labs and vLLM Semantic Router. One SystemOne request asks several router questions about one state, and the answers include the exact spans behind them.
features: Router in one pass. Paste a request and, optionally, a retrieved context and a model's answer. One request returns safety, jailbreak (Noul), domain and modality (Choice) and urgency (Score). It also marks personal data…
Evidence for RAG. Give a question and the retrieved passages. The same request marks the exact supporting spans (broad span head) and returns router decisions about the question.

Ask your documents. One model for the whole RAG, over a built-in knowledge base of 60 Wikipedia paragraphs about ten famous bridges (CC BY-SA 4.0). Vela 2.0 4B embeds the question and retrieves the top 10, reranks them…

Verbatim RAG. Give a question, up to three retrieved documents and an answer template with {slots}. One request marks the evidence, fills each slot with an exact span of a document, extracts your own labels and checks…
